description: This file contains definitions for building multiple kernel packages related to the Linux kernel modules for Buffalo LinkStation power off, Turris Omnia MCU, and Turris Omnia LEDs. It defines package dependencies, titles, configuration options, source files, auto-loading methods, and descriptions for each kernel module.

methods.name: AutoLoad
methods.description: Function invoked to set up autoloading of the linkstation-poweroff module.

methods.name: AutoProbe
methods.description: Function invoked to set up autoloading of the turris-omnia-mcu module.
